mechanism: Recognize ordinary static Sentence Transformers modules by their declared operations and weights, using the same generic local resource, capability, feature and prediction paths as existing encoders. Development installs a freely available asset. The subsequent controller receives neither a model name nor priority and can decline it.
fidelity: Compare the static representation to Sentence Transformers 3.4.1 on 96 fitting texts plus empty, punctuation, repeated-token, non-Latin and long synthetic cases, without any training label. Require finite vectors with maximum absolute error at most 0.000002. Verify using actual original asset signatures from the resource ablation that none disappear and exactly one package is added.
cold: Reuse the sealed 6590-row training package, label-free 1711-row input, already trained corrected recruitment arm, original fitted-data-only vector cache and physical fit guard. Freshly run the static-capable ordinary CLI with the expanded inventory, 32 total classifier fits, 1800 seconds and no method or policy hint. The solver and planner are unchanged; only the asset reader gained declarative support. Recompute native embeddings for out-of-fit predictions after removing the cache. Freeze, replay in a different process, then compare against the previously measured run including its true incumbent. This is paired development on a known working corpus. Count proposals, fits, actual final choice and errors separately. Do not reopen the designated 940 labels or H2 or formal test.
matched_audition: Independently reuse the real seven-source supervised audition and its identical group partitions. Give the newly discovered resource exactly one classifier fit on its original 2685 rows. Compare it on the 1319 nomination rows to the actual four-component previously elected portfolio and allow a 0, 25%, 50% or 100% share for the new resource; ties protect the existing answer. Freeze the share then test on 1318 confirmation rows before scoring a separate 1309-row audit. This is a capability test and cannot substitute for an ordinary autonomous election. Stop if first nomination is zero; an exploratory standalone score may still be reported on that first panel. No new old-component fits.
usage: One ordinary run capped at 32 local fits, plus one physical audition fit. Free publisher downloads. No generative-model requests or course charges.
